page.overview:
Who is CJ Girl?

In , CJ Girl is a member of the Brownie Clan girl scout troupe. Her name is currently unknown.

CJ Girl is a young girl with long straight brown hair with bangs, dark circles under her eyes, black eyes, brown skin, and a thin figure. She wears her girl scout uniform comprised of a white blouse and a brown vest with five blue badges on it. She also wears a knee-length brown pleated skirt, loose white socks, black shoes, and a brown beret with a pink pom pom attached to the top.

She debuted in "Always Be Brownies" while selling brownies for the Grandma CJ Scouts. She encountered April O'Neil who was unsuccessfully selling cookies for her tree conservation fundraiser in the same area. However, once disguised Splinter appeared to help April complete sales and upstaged Julia and her troupe, she relayed a call from Grandma CJ to Julia who wished to meet with her. She later watched April alongside Julia after she was kidnapped and was very impressed by her efforts to resist the troupe. She was defeated and eventually restrained by April.

She and her scout troupe attempted to sell brownies to the Komodo Dragon Karate Dojo students in "Fists of Furry".
